title: VN: Photo & Video Editor
summary: Edit Like a Pro. Without Limits
description:
VN is an all-in-one video and photo editor for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and more. Edit on an intuitive multi-track timeline, create beat-synced videos with AutoCut and BeatsClips templates, make photo collages, use AI Kits for creative generation, add auto captions, and export in up to 4K at 60fps.

[AI Kits]
• Enhance Photo. Improve clarity, detail, and overall photo quality with AI.
• Image Generation. Create images from text prompts for thumbnails, covers, and creative assets.
• Video Generation. Generate video clips with AI to kickstart your editing workflow.

[Smart Tools]
• Auto Captions. Automatically generate subtitles from audio—supports multiple languages, subtitle templates, and animated text styles.
• Text-to-Speech. Generate voiceovers for your videos without recording.
• Video/Photo Cutout. Remove backgrounds from videos and photos in one tap.
• Smooth Slow Motion. AI frame interpolation for fluid slow-mo—even when slowing down standard frame rate footage.

[Video Editing]
• Trim & Merge. Cut clips with frame-accurate precision (0.05s) and merge them into a seamless timeline—with up to 30x zoom.
• Overlay. Add overlay videos, photos, stickers, and text on a multi-layer timeline.
• Masks. Apply masks to layers for precise, creative compositions.
• Reverse, Zoom & Freeze Frame. Play clips backward, add zoom motion, or freeze key moments.
• Add Text & Stickers. Customize text and stickers with keyframe animation.
• Music & Voice-over. Add music, sound effects, and record voice-overs directly in the app.
• Speed Control. Speed up or slow down clips with presets or advanced curve-based speed ramps.
• Keyframe Editing. Add custom keyframe animations with 19 built-in effects and adjustable curves.
• Beat Editing. Add markers to sync your clips with music beats.
• Non-destructive Editing. Save drafts anytime with full undo/redo support.

[Quick Create]
• BeatsClips. Generate beat-synced templates from your video or music—use them in templates or with AutoCut.
• AutoCut. Turn your footage into a finished edit automatically—select a BeatsClips template and sync clips to the beat.
• Story. Organize clips along a storyline first, then generate your video.
• Teleprompter. Read your script while recording talking-head videos—stay on track and never lose your flow.

[Filters, Effects & Transitions]
• Cinematic Filters & LUTs. Apply built-in filters or import LUTs for a professional look.
• Transitions & Effects. Smooth transitions and diverse visual effects for polished edits.

[Templates]
• Custom Templates. Create your own templates and reuse them across projects to keep a consistent style and edit faster.
• Platform Templates. A rich library for every scenario—talking videos, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, Posts, YouTube videos, TikTok covers, YouTube thumbnails, festivals, business, and more.

[Photo Editing & Collage]
• Photo Editing. Add text and stickers to photos, apply filters, and adjust brightness, contrast, and more.
• Photo Collage Maker. Stitch multiple photos with preset layouts—switch compositions anytime.
• Customize Collages. Add backgrounds, filters, adjustments, text, and stickers to your collage.

[Import & Assets]
• Easy Import. Add media via Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, Telegram, or Zip.
• Asset Library. Access stickers, fonts, filters, LUTs, and more.

[Share & Export]
• High-Quality Export. Export up to 4K resolution at 60fps.
• Secure Mode. Protect drafts with passwords and expiration dates.
• Share to Social Apps. Share to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, and more.
